title: feat: add MiMo V2.6 Flash and Pro via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Adds `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash` and `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro` via OpenRouter
- Both pinned to OpenRouter's `xiaomi/fp8` endpoint with `allow_fallbacks: false`, no fallback route declared. OpenRouter also lists `deepinfra/fp8` for both at the same price, but maintainer live probes returned HTTP 429 from it, so it is not a working fallback
- Same price tier as the existing `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` / `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` siblings, verified live against OpenRouter's catalog (2026-09-22), 5.5% OpenRouter credit fee included
- Both models declare `text` + `image` input, matching maintainer E2E on the pinned route. Flash keeps `maxReferenceImages: 10` (ten-image probe passed); Pro sets no limit since only two images were verified

| | Flash | Pro |
|---|---|---|
| Prompt | $0.1477/M | $0.458925/M |
| Completion | $0.2954/M | $0.91785/M |
| Cache read | $0.002954/M | $0.003798/M |
| Context | 1,048,576 | 1,048,576 |

## Test plan
- [x] Added resolver pin tests for both models (`gen.pollinations.ai/test/text/utils/modelResolver.test.ts`)
- [x] Added effective-price snapshot entries
- [x] `npx biome check --write` on all changed files
- [x] Maintainer authenticated Gen + direct Xiaomi-route E2E on `3c2876c`: text, streaming usage, tools, JSON schema, reasoning off, image input, billing matched
- [ ] CI on the latest commit (main merged, Pro image modality corrected)
